project_type: Python 3.11 PyQt6 application with three-layer architecture (core → services/backends → ui/wizards)
build_system: hatchling (pyproject.toml), no build step needed, editable install via pip install -e
test_framework: pytest with pytest-qt for Qt testing, QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen for headless UI tests
verification_instructions: Run ./check from workspace root. All ruff checks must pass (no warnings allowed per pyproject.toml config). All pytest tests must pass. Tests use private D-Bus session bus (dbus-daemon --session) and offscreen Qt platform.
environment_constraints: Never touch developer's real D-Bus session bus (tests use private bus via conftest.py). All file I/O must be injected (paths via Paths dataclass, subprocess via runner parameter) for testability. QApplication created once per test session (qapp_session fixture in tests/conftest.py). Qt platform set to offscreen via QT_QPA_PLATFORM env var in check script.
contribution_requirements: Follow existing three-layer architecture. No Qt or subprocess side effects in core/ and services/ modules. All backends and wizards accept injected dependencies (runner, paths, config, client). Use PyQt6 only (no PyQt5). Match existing code style (ruff enforces it). Greek translation deferred to Phase 8. Desktop file integration and MIME handlers must validate with desktop-file-validate.
key_patterns: Backend pattern: AppImageBackend uses async D-Bus (DbusClient wraps QDBus), FlatpakBackend/PacmanBackend use CommandRunner type alias for testable subprocess calls. Config system: TOML with defaults merged, unknown keys preserved. Paths: XDG-based, injected via Paths dataclass. Tests: pytest fixtures in conftest.py for private_bus_address, qapp_session, dbus_bus, fake_manager. UI tests use qtbot fixture from pytest-qt. Models use QAbstractListModel with roles. All commands defined as module-level list[str] constants, never shell strings.
directory_structure: src/aurelis_software/ contains backends/, core/, services/, ui/, and resources/. tests/ mirrors src structure with backends/, core/, services/, ui/, plus contract/, fixtures/. wizards/ module does not yet exist and must be created under src/aurelis_software/. Desktop files go in src/aurelis_software/resources/. Tests for wizards go in tests/wizards/.
